verdictStatement: ACCEPT. Zero MUST-FIX, zero SHOULD-FIX. The single sarif leftover-join.v10 Stage A finding is landed exactly as the dispatch specifies and no further: obligations[5].rideStanding now reads 'specified-not-leftover', obligations[5].leftoverDesign stays false, executionObligationOwnerToday stays 'none', and summary.specifiedNotLeftover still includes OBL-FC-NONAUTH-TERM-FX. The landing was tested as a partition property rather than as a string swap — the six rows whose rideStanding is 'specified-not-leftover' are now exactly the six members of summary.specifiedNotLeftover, restoring the row-to-bucket agreement that held at the dual-ACCEPT sarif leftover-join.v7 and that sarif leftover-join.v8 through sarif leftover-join.v10 broke. The full v10-to-v11 delta was reconstructed from both sets of bytes: apart from that landing, the speaker re-voicing, the purpose and authorityClaim rewrites, the two remaining metavariable token qualifications, and the predecessorV10 bookkeeping, nothing changed; no flag, digest or standing sentence moved under cover of the edit. The measurement itself is byte-verified: all sixty-three cited digests match live bytes, all eight decision commits resolve to the recordings claimed, required-now 28 and the DR-122 and DR-107 tokens match live file 08, the eight D-344 copies exist and hash as claimed with an empty remainder, the FC-OUTFAIL remainder is real and correctly declared open, and the remasurement of leftover-design of OBL-FC-NONAUTH-TERM-FX to stale is the exact act live D-344 reserved for a leftover-join successor. All sarif leftover-join.v9 and sarif leftover-join.v8 findings remain landed by recount, with the last two bare metavariable tokens now qualified. Three candidate findings were raised and refuted against bytes and against the frozen corpus vocabulary; they are recorded as observations. Every attack in the dispatch is refuted. Under ACCEPT only at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX, the verdict is ACCEPT.
